states.name: AUTHORITY_IDENTITY
states.purpose: Establish and hash-bind the authority so every later artifact can name the exact authority it was produced under.
states.invalidation_scope: If the authority changes after A1 has begun, every downstream artifact bound to the old AUTHORITY_SHA256 is invalidated and must be revalidated.

states.name: IMPLEMENTATION
states.purpose: Build every Experiment III module named in the change matrix. No execution.
states.resume_rules: PER_TASK; completed tasks with passing tests are not redone
states.invalidation_scope: Cohort regeneration invalidates only A1 artifacts while no capture exists. Once any capture exists, cohort regeneration is forbidden and becomes a section 9 amendment.
states.i19_i20_stage_binding_note: I19 (static unit tests) and I20 (CPU integration tests) EXECUTE the suites and are bound to A2, not A1. The superseded phrase 'EXECUTE_TASKS_I01_THROUGH_I20' conflicted with their own lifecycle_stage field in IMPLEMENTATION_TASK_GRAPH.json. A1 WRITES the tests; A2 RUNS them.
states.iii_b_tasks_in_a1_rationale: IB02 and IB03 are III-B-authored but III-A-shared: IB02 supplies the q-generalized qualification primitive that gate 12 requires, and IB03 is the bit-identity regression guard that stops a q-generalization defect from silently altering the III-A cohort. Both are prerequisites of I02. They are IMPLEMENTATION tasks, not III-B runtime stages, so they do not violate the III-A invariant.
states.phase2_start_semantics: A1 begins at PHASE2_START = the instant the independent final audit returns PASS with IMPLEMENTATION_GO = true AND the authority package is committed and frozen. It does NOT wait for any fixed calendar date.
states.deferral_checkpoint: CP0 at 2026-08-31T20:00 local, milestone I10 COMPLETE

states.name: STATIC_VALIDATION
states.purpose: Prove the implementation correct on CPU, with no Minecraft and no model.
states.resume_rules: RERUN_THE_FULL_SUITE; a partial suite run is not evidence
states.invalidation_scope: Any source change invalidates this receipt.
states.group_d_stage_binding_note: Group D is a III-B test suite but runs at A2, alongside groups A and B, on CPU with no Minecraft and no model. Two group-D checks - D.2 (q=0.05 bit-identity regression) and D.4 (all-q qualification, gate 12) - are ADDITIONALLY task-completion gates inside A1 for IB03 and I02 respectively, because gate 12 cannot be evaluated without them. Running them twice is intentional: once as an A1 task gate, once as part of the A2 suite of record.
states.group_d_failure_does_not_block_iii_a: A group-D failure OUTSIDE D.2, D.4 and D.31 is a III-B blocker and does not block III-A closure; III-B proceeds to CLEAN_SKIP if it cannot be repaired in time. D.2, D.4 and D.31 are the exception: they guard the III-A cohort and must pass.
states.checkpoint_instants_are_derived: each is ABSOLUTE_EXPERIMENT_DEADLINE minus that plan's CONSERVATIVE post-A2 tail; they do not move with PHASE2_START

states.name: ENVIRONMENT_PREFLIGHT
states.purpose: Prove the execution host can actually run the experiment before anything expensive starts.
required_evidence: environment_receipt.json naming the stages this host authorizes
states.invalidation_scope: Any environment change invalidates this receipt and every later receipt bound to it.
exit_conditions: environment_receipt.json PASS for the stages this host will run

storage_gate.why_combined: III-B is PROSPECTIVELY_AUTHORIZED_OPTIONAL and A3 always precedes B-GATE, so III-B can never be terminally skipped before A3 runs. The combined gate is therefore always the applicable one.

states.name: P0_VISIBILITY_CALIBRATION
states.purpose: Select L1/L2/L3 by an outcome-blind, image-only measurement, before any Experiment III model inference.
entry_conditions: A3 == PASS on the capture host
states.resume_rules: PER_(CONDITION, PLACEMENT, BLOCK); completed verified units are not re-measured
states.invalidation_scope: A mask change invalidates every candidate at that placement. A candidate re-measure invalidates only that candidate's placement scores and the selection.
exit_conditions: P0_SELECTION_RECEIPT with P0_RESULT == P0_PASS and a hash-bound selected triple

states.name: P1_ENGINEERING_PILOT
states.purpose: Prove the whole pipeline end to end on sacrificial identities, so no production identity is ever spent on debugging.
entry_conditions: A3 == PASS on capture and extraction hosts
states.invalidation_scope: A pipeline change invalidates the pilot receipt; re-pilot the affected span.

states.name: P2_PROSPECTIVE_FREEZE
states.purpose: The final scientific freeze. After this, nothing scientific may change.
states.invalidation_scope: Re-freezing after production has begun invalidates every capture bound to the superseded package.

states.name: PRODUCTION_CAPTURE
states.purpose: Capture the frozen 125-unit production matrix.
entry_conditions: A3 == PASS on the capture host
states.retry_rules: SAME_FROZEN_UNIT_ONLY; all failed attempts retained with provenance; the FIRST technically valid attempt is kept; bounded by the frozen attempt cap in P2
states.resume_rules: PER_CAPTURE_UNIT_VIA_THE_LEDGER: PLANNED -> RUNNING -> CAPTURED -> VALIDATED -> DURABLE -> COMPLETE_VALIDATED_DURABLE; units already COMPLETE are skipped
states.invalidation_scope: A sentinel failure invalidates only the affected as-yet-unmodeled capture batch. A per-unit failure invalidates only that unit.

states.name: CAPTURE_COHORT_VALIDATION
states.purpose: Close the cohort and decide, without outcomes, what population the analysis has.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards; this stage only reads.
exit_conditions: cohort_closure_receipt.json with N_complete and the selected attrition branch

states.name: ACTIVATION_EXTRACTION
states.purpose: Produce the frozen activation tensors from exactly one forward per target row.
entry_conditions: A3 == PASS on the GPU host
states.resume_rules: PER_UNIT: PLANNED -> RUNNING -> EXTRACTED -> VALIDATED -> DURABLE -> COMPLETE; COMPLETE units are skipped without reading bytes; DURABLE units are re-sealed; EXTRACTED units are re-validated rather than re-extracted
states.invalidation_scope: A source-capture change invalidates every array derived from it. An extraction-spec change invalidates ALL arrays.

states.name: EXTRACTION_VALIDATION
states.purpose: Independently verify the extraction inventory.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards; this stage only reads and re-hashes.

states.name: FEATURE_CONSTRUCTION
states.purpose: Build the three frozen representations and the pixel-baseline features.
states.invalidation_scope: A representation change invalidates every downstream fit and the prediction lock.

states.name: PREDICTION_LOCK
states.purpose: Emit and hash-lock every held-out prediction before any summary statistic is computed or viewed.
states.invalidation_scope: Any feature or fold change invalidates the whole lock.

states.name: BASELINES_CONTROLS
states.purpose: Produce the five baselines and the L0 interpretability control.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: PRIMARY_ANALYSIS
states.purpose: Compute the three frozen primary estimands. Nothing else.
states.resume_rules: RECOMPUTE_FROM_THE_LOCK; the lock is never regenerated
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: TEMPORAL_ANALYSIS
states.purpose: The two predeclared temporal-rescue contrasts.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: CONTEXT_AGE_ANALYSIS
states.purpose: The descriptive context-age boundary evidence.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: STATISTICAL_ADJUDICATION
states.purpose: Map computed results onto the pre-registered adjudication matrix and fix the permitted wording.
states.retry_rules: UNLIMITED; the underlying numbers never change
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: SCIENTIFIC_PACKAGE
states.purpose: Assemble the terminal evidence package.
states.invalidation_scope: None backwards.

states.name: FINAL_CLOSURE
states.purpose: Declare Experiment III scientifically complete.
states.invalidation_scope: None; terminal.
exit_conditions: EXPERIMENT_III_COMPLETE = true, or an explicit disclosed no-claim closure

states.name: III_B_MANIFEST_GENERATION
states.purpose: Materialize the III-B q cells from the frozen III-A cohort.
entry_conditions: IB02 and IB03 PASS (they are A1 tasks and gate I02; by the time A1 is PASS they are green)
states.invalidation_scope: III-B only. III-A is untouched.
states.all_q_gate_note: Every admitted III-A identity has ALREADY been proven, at A1, to qualify at all three frozen q. B-GEN therefore RE-VERIFIES rather than discovers. A B-GEN qualification failure at a binding q is an implementation defect (the two evaluations disagree), not a cohort problem, and never regenerates the III-A cohort.
states.q_high_fallback_note: If the B-PILOT technical gate forces the q_high fallback to 0.15, cells at 0.15 were NOT covered by binding gate 12 and some may fail qualification. That is III-B-local attrition handled by the drop ladder (LEVEL_3, first >=15 complete triples in frozen priority order). It NEVER regenerates or alters the III-A cohort.

states.name: III_B_ENGINEERING_PILOT
states.purpose: Prove the III-B path end to end on sacrificial identities and qualify q_high technically.
entry_conditions: A3 == PASS on capture and GPU hosts
states.retry_rules: UNLIMITED_ON_PILOT_UNITS; exactly ONE q=0.15 fallback re-pilot
states.invalidation_scope: III-B only, unless a shared III-A defect is proven, in which case section 9 applies.
exit_conditions: iii_b_pilot_receipt.json PASS, or III_B = SKIPPED if the fallback also fails

states.name: III_B_LAUNCH_GATE
states.purpose: Decide whether to launch III-B, using time, technical state and resources ONLY.
required_evidence: iii_b_launch_gate_receipt.json recording every input and the verdict
states.resume_rules: NOT_RESUMABLE; the decision is made at most twice
states.invalidation_scope: None. A NO-GO is a CLEAN_SKIP, not a failure.

storage_requirements.superseded_reason: mixed GB/GiB, applied whole-program totals to an incremental decision, and double counted one filesystem as two pools

states.name: III_B_PRODUCTION_CAPTURE
states.purpose: Capture the 50 new III-B production units.
expected_outputs: per-unit raw streams, frames, receipts and durable receipts
states.retry_rules: SAME_FROZEN_UNIT_ONLY; first technically valid attempt is kept
states.invalidation_scope: III-B only.
exit_conditions: all planned units COMPLETE_VALIDATED_DURABLE, or a drop level is applied

states.name: III_B_EXTRACTION
states.purpose: Extract L19 PREVIOUS+CURRENT over the occluded and VIS rows.
controlling_inputs: the existing III-A L4 q=0.05 captures
states.invalidation_scope: III-B only. III-A activations are never invalidated by a III-B extraction failure.

states.name: III_B_ORACLE_LEDGER
states.purpose: Generate and validate the oracle sigma ledger.
states.retry_rules: UNLIMITED; the oracle is deterministic and cheap
states.invalidation_scope: III-B analysis only.

states.name: III_B_U2_ANALYSIS
states.purpose: Fit the U2 probe, lock predictions, and compute the three U2 statistics with all controls.
states.invalidation_scope: III-B analysis only. A SCIENTIFIC_NULL here is a result, not a blocker.
exit_conditions: iii_b_u2_results.json emitted with the conjunction adjudicated

states.name: III_B_U3_AND_CALIBRATION
states.purpose: Compute the U3 dynamics and the calibration battery.
states.invalidation_scope: III-B analysis only.

states.name: III_B_RESULT_LOCK_AND_CLOSURE
states.purpose: Adjudicate the belief-state ladder and close III-B.
states.retry_rules: UNLIMITED; the underlying numbers never change
states.invalidation_scope: None. Terminal for III-B.
exit_conditions: iii_b_closure_receipt.json emitted with RESULT_LOCKED, CLEAN_SKIP, or TERMINALLY_ADJUDICATED
